subject: Request: one-off discount for Slate Health after prefetch KV delay
messages:
From: Emma Carter <emma@slatehealth.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: Tom Alvarez <tom.alvarez@slatehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Unexpected throughput hit after KV prefetch delay (impacting March rollout)

Neha —

Thanks again for the quick demo last week. We started the internal canary this morning and hit a hard throughput regression once a subset of requests missed the prefetch/KV cache. This is blocking our March rollout window to production.

High level:
- Error surface: 5-8x per-token latency increase for requests that miss the prefix cache.
- Impact: user-facing latency spikes during peak tests, causing timeouts on downstream services.
- Business: March launch is tied to a payer integration; slipping this month costs the team an estimated $120k in ARR this quarter if delayed.

Can Redwood provide a short-term commercial accommodation (one-off discount or credit) while the prefetch roadmap item is accelerated? We want to keep momentum with customers and we appreciate how fast the team moved in the trial.

Logs & plots attached. Happy to jump on a call.

—Emma
Product Lead, Integrations
Slate Health
[Attachment: integration_log_0308.txt (text/plain)]
[Attachment: prefetch-latency-plot.png (image/png)]

From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: Emma Carter <emma@slatehealth.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 9 Mar 2028 16:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected throughput hit after KV prefetch delay (impacting March rollout)

Emma —

Thanks for the detailed notes and the attachments. Really sorry you hit this during the canary — appreciate the data. I copied Marissa (Sales Manager) and Lauren (Product Ops) to loop in roadmap and commercial.

Short-term plan:
- I'll coordinate an accelerated patch for the prefetch path with Product Ops.
- For the commercial ask: represent what would be most helpful (credit vs. percent discount vs. extended trial). I'll start the approval path but want to confirm internal impact first.

Would a 30-day service credit sized to expected ARR loss be helpful (you can propose a target and we'll evaluate)? Also open to a one-time discount on the first month of committed Dedicated capacity.

I'll follow up after I sync with Marissa and Finance.

Neha
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment referenced: proposed-mpa-SlateHealth.pdf (application/pdf)]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Mar 2028 09:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected throughput hit after KV prefetch delay (impacting March rollout)

Neha —

Per our convo, I support a conservative one-off accommodation to protect the relationship but want guardrails. Suggestion:
- Offer option A: 25% one-time invoice credit applied to the first month of Dedicated commit (if Slate lands on Dedicated within 60 days).
- Option B: Service credit equal to 30 days of expected incremental token spend (capped at $50k).

Require approvals: Finance (Aditya) sign-off + CS acknowledgement that the technical mitigations are tracked in the postmortem and a delivery ETA is set.

Advise that this is a limited goodwill make-good and not a precedent for future roadmap delays. If Aditya greenlights, Neha you can communicate to Slate and lock option and expiry.

—Marissa
Sales Manager, Redwood Inference

From: aditya_rao@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai
Date: Sat, 10 Mar 2028 14:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Unexpected throughput hit after KV prefetch delay (impacting March rollout)

TL;DR: Finance OK to approve Option A or B with conditions.

Details:
- Option A (25% one-time Dedicated-month credit) APPROVED up to $45,000. Requires signed letter of intent for Dedicated commit within 60 days and PO within 90 days.
- Option B (30-day token-equivalent credit) APPROVED up to $50,000 if engineering provides a remediation plan and ETA within 5 business days; CS must confirm verification run after fix.

Please include a short Mutual Action Plan (MAP) listing deliverables/ETA and the chosen remediation path. We'll record the concession in the CRM and route appropriately for financial tracking.

Aditya
Head of Revenue Ops, Redwood Inference
